Install as /etc/durable-park/approvers.json (root:root 0644; no secrets). primary_minutes: how long Yaakov has to answer an approval. backup_approver: null = deny after primary_minutes with a clear note; or {"name": "<the backup person>", "escalation_path": "<withHuman escalation path that includes them>", "minutes": 60, "teams_webhook_env": "<optional env var with their Teams webhook URL>"}.
